content: Sɑnɑm mɛ Isirelibɑ bɑ Kɑnɑnibɑ kɑmiɑ, yerɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ Siloɔ. Mɑ bɑ kuu bekuruɡii te ɡirɑ tèn mi bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃.
N deemɑ Isirelibɑn bwese kɛrɑ nɔɔbɑ yiruwɑ yɑ ǹ ɡinɑ tem wɑ.
Mɑ Yosue u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑɑ yerɑ̀ i mɑrɑ i sere dɑ i tem mɛ mwɑ mɛ Gusunɔ bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑn Yinni u bɛɛ wɛ̃.
Yen sɔ̃, bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyere sɔɔ, i tɔmbu itɑ itɑ ɡɔsio n bu ɡɔri bu tem mɛ mɛɛrim dɑ, kpɑ bu wɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ koo mu burɑnɑ burɑnɑ kpɑ bu wurɑmɑ bu mɑn sɔ̃ nɡe mɛ n sɑ̃ɑ.
Bɑ koo mu bɔnu kowɑ wɑsi nɔɔbɑ yiru. Adɑmɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ mi bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, Yosɛfun bwese kɛri mɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i doo tɛ̃, i tem mɛ bɔnu ko wɑsi nɔɔbɑ yiru ye, kpɑ i nɑ i mɑn sɔ̃. Kpɑ su mu tɛtɛ toosi Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinnin wuswɑɑɔ su kɑ wɑ mɛ mu sɑ̃ɑ bɛɛn bɑɑwureɡim.

Adɑmɑ Lefibɑ bɑ ǹ ko bɑ n tem mɔ. Domi bɑ kon sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yɑ̃ku kowobu. N deemɑ Gɑdi kɑ Rubɛnin bwese kɛri kɑ Mɑnɑsen bwese kɛrɑn sukum bɑ tem wɑ kɔ Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ mɛ Mɔwisi, Yinni Gusunɔn sɔm kowo u bu bɔnu kuɑ.
Yen biru tɔn be, bɑ dɑ bɑ tem mɛ bukiɑnɑ bɑ kuɑ ye Yosue u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Mɑ bɑ ye kpuro yoruɑ ye bɑ wɑ mi, kɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ tem mɛ kɑ mɛn wusu burɑnɑ burɑnɑ mɑ bɑ wurɑmɑ Yosuen mi Siloɔ.
Yen biru Yosue u bu tem mɛ bɔnu kuɑ kɑ tɛtɛ Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ, u bwese kɛrɑ bɑɑyere yen tem wɛ̃.
Tem mɛ bɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn
bwese kɛrɑ wɛ̃
Tem mɛ bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ tɛtɛ toosi, Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bwese kɛrɑ yɑ mu di. Ben tem mɛ, mu wɑ̃ɑwɑ Yudɑn bwese kɛrɑɡim kɑ Yosɛfun bwese kɛriɡim bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ, tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru tɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ sɑɑ Yuudɛnin di n kɑ ɡirɑri Yerikon sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ, mɑ tɑ dɑ ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yerɔ sere Bɛti Afɛniɔ mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi.

Sɑɑ min diyɑ tɑ dɑ tɑ yɔ̃rɑ Lusiɔ ye bɑ rɑ mɑɑ soku Betɛli, sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ. Min diyɑ tɑ mɑɑ dɑ tɑ ɡirɑri Atɑrɔtu Adɑriɔ. Mɑ tɑ ɡuu te bɛwɑ te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ Bɛti Horonin sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrɔ. Bɛti Horoni ye, yɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔwɑ sɔɔ.
Sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ mɑɑ, tɑ dɑwɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ sɑɑ ɡuu ten di n kɑ ɡirɑri Bɑɑlin wuuɔ ɡe bɑ mɑɑ sokumɔ Yɑrimun wuu. Wuu ɡe, ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yudɑbɑn wuu.
Sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ mɑɑ, tɑ dɑwɑ sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ sɑɑ Yɑrimun wuun di sere Nɛfitoɑn bwiiyɔ.
Sɑɑ mɑɑ min di, tɑ dɑwɑ ɡuu te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ Bɛni Hinɔmun wɔwɑn deedeeru, Refɑbɑn wɔwɑn sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ. Mɑ tɑ dɑ Yebusibɑn ɡuunun sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ n kɑ ɡirɑri Eni Roɡɛliɔ.
Sɑɑ mɑɑ min di, tɑ dɑwɑ Eni Semɛsiɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ kɑ Gelilɔtuɔ, ɡunɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Adumimun deedeeru. Min di tɑ mɑɑ dɑ sere Bohɑnin kperɔ. Rubɛnin biin yĩsirɑ bɑ kɑ kpee te sokumɔ.
Mɑ tɑ dɑ Yuudɛnin wɔwɑɔ ɡuunun sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ
sere kɑ Bɛti Hoɡulɑɔ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑ mi Yuudɛnin dɑɑrɑ suremɔ nim wɔ̃ku bɔruɡuuɔ, sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑrɔ.
Yuudɛnin dɑɑrɑ tɑ sɑ̃ɑ tem mɛn nɔɔ burɑ yeru sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ. Mɛn nɔrɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bwese kɛrɑn tem mu yɑsum nɛ.
Wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, siyɑ Yeriko kɑ Bɛti Hoɡulɑ kɑ Emɛki Kesisi,
kɑ Bɛti Arɑbɑ kɑ Semɑrɑimu kɑ Betɛli,
kɑ Afimu, kɑ Pɑrɑ, kɑ Ofɑrɑ,
kɑ Kefɑɑ Amɔnɑi, kɑ Ofini, kɑ Gebɑ. Wuu si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wɔkurɑ yiru, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu.
Sin ɡɑsɑ, Gɑbɑoni, kɑ Rɑmɑ kɑ Berɔtu,
kɑ Misipe, kɑ Kefirɑ, kɑ Mɔsɑ,
kɑ Rekɛmu kɑ Yiipɛɛli, kɑ Tɑreɑlɑ,
kɑ Selɑ, kɑ Elɛfu, kɑ Yebusi ye bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Yerusɑlɛmu, kɑ Gibeɑ kɑ Kiriɑti. Si kpuro su sɑ̃ɑwɑ wusu wɔkurɑ nnɛ, ɡen bɑɑɡere kɑ ɡen bɑru kpɑɑnu. Yeni kpurowɑ n kuɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bwese kɛrɑn tubi.
